# PINTE (品特) - Premium Hot Stamping Foil Manufacturer
> PINTE is a leading high-end **hot stamping foil**, **cold foil**, **digital foil**, **pigment foil**, **holographic foil**, and **metallic foil** manufacturer specializing in foil products for packaging, leather, plastic, and digital printing. With 25+ years of coating technology expertise, PINTE serves international markets including **Vietnam**, **Southeast Asia**, **Thailand**, **Malaysia**, **Indonesia**, **Singapore**, **United States**, **United Kingdom**, **Germany**, and Western countries.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2000 (25+ years experience)
- Production base: 200,000㎡ modern factory facility in Dongguan, Guangdong, China
- Daily output: 60,000 meters
- R&D investment: 15% of annual revenue
- Certifications: ISO9001, RoHS, EN71-3, ASTM-F963
- Target markets: Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Southeast Asia, Europe, North America
- Core product categories: **Hot Stamping Foil**, **Cold Foil**, **Digital Foil**, **Pigment Foil**, **Holographic Foil**, **Metallic Foil**, **Glitter Powder**
